title: Sign tombstones/edits; revalidate edited replies
description: Tombstone and EditRecord are unsigned (04:256-264), yet 16-interop-streams:171 makes receivers MUST remove references and 16:168 calls tombstones signed: any operator can censor another's users. Edit step 3 never updates signingRecord. 16:143 swaps edited reply CID without re-running validation: moderation bypass. Fix: author-signed tombstone/EditRecord, new SigningRecord on edit, edits re-run reply validation.
